recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, vertical perspective of a narrow, rushing white-water river flowing through a deep, mossy rock canyon, framed by lush evergreen foliage and broad-leafed plants in the foreground. The scene is characterized by soft, natural lighting and a rich palette of forest greens and earthy browns.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright white river acts as a central vertical spine against dark rocks.
Lush green foliage in the upper left balances the heavy mossy rocks on the right.
The typography is anchored at the top center, overlapping the dark forest background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The river occupies the central vertical third, receding into the distance. Foliage is scaled to frame the top and left edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white water in the lower center serves as the primary light source and anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the river from the bottom center upwards, leading to the text at the top, then circulates through the surrounding greenery.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark shadowed crevices between rocks provide depth and negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest greens and mossy olives define the environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale blue of the rushing water provide high-value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm ochre and earthy browns in the rock faces.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between water and rocks; medium saturation in the greens to maintain a naturalistic feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to organic earth tones

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a clean, all-caps serif with moderate spacing.
Secondary text uses a fluid, continuous cursive script with long horizontal flourishes.
Script text is significantly smaller than the serif text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script text features extended entry and exit strokes that underline or span the width of the primary text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a structured, authoritative serif and a personal, organic script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule-like flourishes in the script text

preserve: All-caps serif for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Classic humanist serif qualities with elegant proportions.
Captures the fluid, informal nature of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-angle photograph of a narrow white-water river flowing through a mossy rock canyon. Include lush green evergreen branches in the top left and broad-leafed plants in the mid-left foreground. The lighting should be soft and natural, emphasizing textures of moss and wet stone.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the primary title in white all-caps serif at the top center. Directly underneath, add a subtitle in a warm gold-colored cursive script with long horizontal flourishes extending from the first and last letters.

verificationChecks: Is the river the brightest element in the composition?
Does the foliage frame the top and left edges effectively?
Is the text legible against the dark background?
Does the script text feel organic and handwritten?

adjustableVariables: Color of the script text (gold vs. white)
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the moss and rocks

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the water looks like a continuous flow rather than static blocks.
Check that the green tones are varied and naturalistic.
Verify the script text flourishes do not obscure the primary serif text.
Confirm the overall mood is serene and grounded.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vertical nature landscape (canyon/river) with a top-weighted typographic lockup featuring a serif/script pairing.
